author: Edge
text:
Hi Andrew,

Nice journal :)

Take your time and dont burn out!

We can see all over the charts where the IT's start different
manipulative techniques in order to accumulate etc. These are often
Algos programmed at different levels which leave their foot prints. The
foot prints are not left like classic S/D traders claim, in fact most
rbr/dbd, rbd/dbr are mirages.

Also look at IFs blue line, it occurs at an important place where the
IT's made a shift in behavior to achieve desired outcomes.

A great exercise to do is to look on the chart and see these areas,
where they shift behaviors, the edges of these areas can be quite
lucrative at times :)

author: Kavya
text:
Hey yo , dengaima! there is no engulf South to take that supply for
shorting ! Instead there is engulf north where PA was created to trap
herd.

Remember IF's Quote,Funny
 you should say that, as I teach to always and only trade within a flag.
 Sometimes the flag will already have developed, and sometimes the flag
is to be made while you're in the trade. Either way, always trade
within a flag.

If you can look beyond S/D, you'll see that the Flag Limit is the only
true place to look for PA for a trade. Trade these levels and
you're taking gambling out of your method.
